definitions.explanation: Describes a person who tends not to trust others or who is inclined to doubt what they are told. Formed from 疑い (doubt) + 深い (deep).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: He's looking at us with suspicious eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧だろう。
examples.english: That person is so skeptical that they probably won't believe us easily.

notes:
FORMS:
Follows the productive ～{深|ぶか}い pattern meaning "deeply inclined toward ~": ⟦{用心|ようじん}{深|ぶか}い→用心深い：16988_youjinbukai⟧ (cautious), ⟦{信仰|しんこう}→信仰：03685_shinkou⟧{深|ぶか}い (devout), ⟦{嫉妬|しっと}→嫉妬：05406_shitto⟧{深|ぶか}い (jealous).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a distrustful personality)
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (suspicious eyes)
- {疑|うたが}い{深|ぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a skeptical person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猜疑|さいぎ}{心|しん}→猜疑心：21293_saigishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: suspicious-natured — more formal, emphasizes paranoia
- ⟦{懐疑的|かいぎてき}→懐疑的：09406_kaigiteki⟧: skeptical — more formal/academic, used for intellectual doubt
- ⟦{用心|ようじん}{深|ぶか}い→用心深い：16988_youjinbukai⟧: cautious — focuses on carefulness rather than distrust
